title: CIRSEC Baselines - tailoring file
description: How an organization adapts a released standard without forking it: pick a profile, override parameters within their bounds, exclude controls with a justification. Kept in the organization's own repository, read by scanners and generators.

version.description: Standard release this tailoring was written for. Tools warn when used with another one.

owner.description: Team or person accountable for the deviations.

parameters.description: Overrides, keyed by control ID then parameter name. Must respect minimum, maximum and allowed.

exclude.description: Controls not evaluated nor fixed. Reported as excluded.

until.description: Review date. Tools warn once it is past.

include.description: Controls from other profiles of the same standard to add.

fixes.description: Opt in to fixes disabled by default (lockout_risk), keyed by control ID.
